words.origin: 拉丁语 figura（形状、轮廓）
words.native_definition: a shape, outline, or form that can be recognized; a number or amount; a person of a particular kind
words.core_concept: a recognizable form – 一个可被辨认的形态
words.core_image: 远处看到一个人的轮廓，能认出身形；纸上的符号也是代表数量的形状
examples: I saw a figure standing in the dark.
Sales figures increased by 10% this quarter.
He is an important public figure.
semantic_expansions: 图形/形态：figure 的本义——一个可辨认的轮廓
人物/身材：人的可见轮廓 → 人的形象 → 身材；社会中的'形象' → 人物（public figure）
数字：链条为 形状 → 记号/符号 → 数字符号（古英语经拉丁语 figura 引申），非直接推导
认为：figure out 把模糊信息'整理成清晰轮廓' → 弄明白；美式口语 figure that 引申为'料想'
words.root_logic: figur（形状）本身即词根，无词缀 → 可辨认的形态：身影/人物/身材；'数字'义经'记号/符号'间接引申（见语义扩展）
words.recall_hint: figur（形状）→ 能被认出的轮廓；也用于代表数量的符号

words.origin: 拉丁语 configurare：con-（一起）+ figura（形状）
words.native_definition: to arrange parts into a particular structure or form
words.core_concept: arranging components into a desired form – 把零件组合成目标结构
words.core_image: 工程师把散落的电路模块按目标排列，拼成一台整机
examples: Please configure the network settings before starting.
The software can be configured to run in different modes.
semantic_expansions: 配置/设置/组合：这三个中文词对应同一个英文概念——把零件组合成目标结构，只是场景不同译法不同（IT 里译'配置'，机械里译'组合'）
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ figur（形状）→ 把零件组合成目标形状 → 配置

words.origin: 拉丁语 figura + -ative（与形状/形象相关的）
words.native_definition: using words in a way that departs from their literal meaning; based on figures or symbols
words.core_concept: turning an image into a meaning – 把形象转化为比喻含义
words.core_image: 一个具体的形象（figure）被借去表达抽象的意思，如用'山的腿'表达山脚
examples: 'He has a heart of stone' is a figurative expression.
semantic_expansions: 比喻的：用具体形象（figure）借指抽象含义；象征的：用形象代表另一事物——都是'借形象表意'
words.root_logic: figur（形象）+ -ative（…的）→ 借形象表达 → 比喻的

words.origin: dis-（去除、相反）+ figura（形状）
words.native_definition: to spoil the appearance or shape of something
words.core_concept: destroying the recognizable form – 毁掉可辨认的形态
words.core_image: 一张清晰的脸被划伤，轮廓被破坏，认不出来了
examples: The building was disfigured by graffiti.
semantic_expansions: 损毁外形/使变丑：毁掉可辨认的形态（figure）→ 外形被破坏自然就变丑，同一概念的两种译法
words.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ figur（形状）→ 毁掉形状 → 损毁外形

words.origin: 拉丁语 configuratio（排列成形）
words.native_definition: the way in which parts are arranged to form a whole
words.core_concept: the resulting arrangement of parts – 零件组合后的整体形态
words.core_image: 乐高拼好后的最终成品造型
examples: The configuration of the new system takes time.
semantic_expansions: 配置/布局/结构：组合（configure）后的结果形态，同一概念在不同场景的译法
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ figur（形状）+ -ation（名词）→ 组合后的形态 → 配置/结构
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ figur（形状）+ -ation → 各部件被组合成的那个形态

words.origin: 拉丁语 pressura（按压）
words.native_definition: the force or weight that pushes against something; the stress of a difficult situation
words.core_concept: force pushing down or against – 施加下来的力
words.core_image: 上面的重量持续往下压，压得喘不过气
examples: The pressure of work is increasing.
Blood pressure should be checked regularly.
semantic_expansions: 压强/压力：physical force pressing down——物理的力（血压、大气压）；逼迫：无形的'力'加于人→精神压力、被迫（pressure sb. to do）
words.root_logic: press（压）+ -ure（名词）→ 压下来的力 → 压力
words.recall_hint: press（压）+ -ure → 压下来所形成的那种力

words.origin: im-（往里）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to press something firmly into a surface; to make someone feel admiration or respect
words.core_concept: pressing an image into someone's mind – 把印象压进心里
words.core_image: 印章把图案压进纸里；一件事深深印在脑海里
examples: Her performance impressed the judges.
The view impressed itself on my memory.
semantic_expansions: 压印：把图案往表面里压（物理）；铭刻：把印记深深刻入（记忆/心灵）；使印象深刻：im- 往里压 → 把记号压进心里 → 留下深刻印象
words.root_logic: im-（往里）+ press（压）→ 把印记压进心里 → 印象深刻

words.origin: ex-（向外）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to press out; to show or say what you think or feel
words.core_concept: pressing thoughts outward – 把心里的想法压出来
words.core_image: 内心的话像被挤压的牙膏一样从出口流出来
examples: She expressed her gratitude in a letter.
Words cannot express how I feel.
semantic_expansions: 表达：ex- 向外压 → 把内心的想法'压'出来
明确的：express 作形容词（expressly）→ 明确说出的
快递：express mail 原义'以专门加急的方式发送'（express = 专门的），与'压'无关，独立引申
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ press（压）→ 把内心的话压出来 → 表达；'快递/明确的'义为独立引申，与'压'无关（见语义扩展）
words.synonym_note: express 表达感情/想法；describe 描述细节；state 正式陈述
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ press（压）→ 把内里的东西往外压出来

words.origin: sub-（在下面）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to press down and stop something from happening, spreading, or being seen
words.core_concept: pressing something down so it cannot rise – 压下去不让它冒出来
words.core_image: 用手把要冒出来的气泡压回水面下
examples: He suppressed a laugh.
The government suppressed the protest.
semantic_expansions: 压制/抑制/镇压：sup-（在下）压 → 把东西压下去不让它冒出来；压住情绪=抑制，用强力压住反抗=镇压，同一概念
words.root_logic: sup-（在下）+ press（压）→ 压下去不让冒出来 → 压制/抑制

words.origin: com-（一起）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to press things together into a smaller space
words.core_concept: pressing together into less space – 把散的东西压到一起变小
words.core_image: 把一堆棉花压成一个小方块
examples: The file was compressed to save space.
semantic_expansions: 压缩/压紧：com- 一起压 → 把散的东西压到一起变小
words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ press（压）→ 压到一起 → 压缩
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ press（压）→ 把东西往一起压紧

words.origin: 拉丁语 formalis（与形式有关的）
words.native_definition: following an official or established form; serious and proper
words.core_concept: having a set form – 有固定形式/规格的
words.core_image: 宴会厅里按规矩摆放的整齐餐具，一切都有固定形态
examples: You need formal approval to proceed.
semantic_expansions: 正式的：符合固定形式/规格的（formal dinner 按形式办的宴会）；形式上的：只停留在形式层面的（a formal apology 走过场的道歉）
words.root_logic: form（形状）+ -al（…的）→ 有固定形式的 → 正式的

words.origin: in-（进入）+ forma（形状）
words.native_definition: to give someone knowledge that shapes their understanding
words.core_concept: putting knowledge into shape – 把信息塞进对方心里形成认知
words.core_image: 把一条信息'放进'对方的头脑，对方的认知随之成形
examples: Please inform us of any changes.
semantic_expansions: 通知/告知：in- 进入 + form 成形 → 让信息在对方脑中成形 → 告知
words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ form（成形）→ 让信息在脑中成形 → 告知

words.origin: trans-（跨越）+ forma（形状）
words.native_definition: to change completely from one form to another
words.core_concept: moving across from one shape to another – 从一个形态跨到另一个形态
words.core_image: 毛毛虫跨越形态变成蝴蝶
examples: The city has been transformed in ten years.
semantic_expansions: 转变/改造/转换：trans- 跨越 + form 形态 → 从一个形态跨到另一个形态；改造=主动使它转变形态，转换=形态/功能切换
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ form（形状）→ 跨越形态界限 → 转变
words.recall_hint: trans-（跨越）+ form（形状）→ 跨过原本的形态变成另一个

words.origin: per-（完全）+ forma（形状）
words.native_definition: to carry out completely; to give a performance
words.core_concept: bringing something fully into form – 把一件事完整地做成形
words.core_image: 舞台上演员把整个节目完整地呈现出来
examples: The doctor performed the surgery successfully.
She performed beautifully on stage.
semantic_expansions: 执行：per- 完全 + form 成形 → 把事完整做成形；表演：在舞台上把节目完整呈现出来；表现：完成的质量（performance）
words.root_logic: per-（完全）+ form（成形）→ 完整做成形 → 执行/表演

words.origin: re-（重新）+ forma（形状）
words.native_definition: to form or shape again; to improve by making changes
words.core_concept: reshaping into a better form – 重新塑造成更好的形态
words.core_image: 把变形的东西重新捏回规整的样子
examples: The government promised to reform the education system.
semantic_expansions: 改革/改良/改造：re- 重新 + form 成形 → 重新塑造成更好的形态，三个译法只是力度/对象不同
words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ form（成形）→ 重新成形 → 改革

words.origin: ad-（朝向）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to pull something toward yourself; to make someone interested
words.core_concept: pulling toward – 朝自己方向拉
words.core_image: 磁铁把铁屑朝自己拉过来；目光也被那个方向拉走
examples: The new shop attracts many customers.
semantic_expansions: 吸引/招引：at- 朝向 + tract 拉 → 把对方朝自己拉过来
words.root_logic: at-（朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 朝自己拉 → 吸引

words.origin: ex-（向外）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to pull something out, especially with effort
words.core_concept: pulling out – 用力往外拉出来
words.core_image: 用镊子把嵌在肉里的刺一点点拉出体外
examples: The dentist extracted the tooth.
Oil is extracted from these seeds.
semantic_expansions: 拔出：物理地往外拉（拔牙）；提取：从混合物中拉出（炼油）；摘录：从长文中'拉出'片段
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ tract（拉）→ 往外拉出 → 提取
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ tract（拉）→ 把某物从整体里拉出来

words.origin: con-（一起）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to pull together; a written agreement binding parties together
words.core_concept: pulling together – 拉到一起 / 让双方绑在一起的约定
words.core_image: 两人握手把关系拉在一起，签下把双方绑定的文书
examples: Metal contracts when it cools.
They signed a contract for the project.
semantic_expansions: 合同：con- 一起拉 → 把双方'拉'到一起的约定
收缩：拉到一起 → 变紧变小
感染：源自拉丁语 contrahere morbum（把病拉到自己身上）→ 染上，链条较长
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tract（拉）→ 拉到一起 → 合同/收缩；'感染'义为独立引申链（把病拉到自己身上），见语义扩展
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tract（拉）→ 把两方拉到一起并绑定；也指体积被拉紧变小

words.origin: dis-（分开）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to pull someone's attention away from something
words.core_concept: pulling attention apart – 把注意力拉开
words.core_image: 一条线把目光从书本上拉向窗外
examples: The noise distracted me from my work.
semantic_expansions: 使分心/分散注意力：dis- 分开 + tract 拉 → 把注意力从一处'拉走'
words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ tract（拉）→ 把注意力拉开 → 分心

words.origin: 拉丁语 tractor（拉的东西）
words.native_definition: a powerful vehicle that pulls farm machinery
words.core_concept: a thing that pulls – 用来拉拽的机器
words.core_image: 田野里轰鸣的机器拖着犁前进
examples: The farmer drove the tractor across the field.
semantic_expansions: -or 表示'东西' → 拉东西的机器 → 拖拉机
words.root_logic: tract（拉）+ -or（东西）→ 拉东西的机器 → 拖拉机
words.recall_hint: tract（拉）+ -or（施动者）→ 负责拉动的那个机器

words.origin: 拉丁语 positio（放置之处）
words.native_definition: the place where something is put; a job; a point of view
words.core_concept: where something is placed – 被放置的位置
words.core_image: 棋子被摆放在棋盘上的某个格子里
examples: Please find the position marked on the map.
She applied for a manager position.
semantic_expansions: 位置：pos（放置）→ 被放置的地方
职位：人在组织中被'放置'的层级
立场：观点所处的'位置'（take a position）
words.root_logic: pos（放置）+ -ition（名词）→ 被放置之处 → 位置/职位

words.origin: com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to put parts together to form a whole; to write music or a text
words.core_concept: placing parts together – 把各部分放到一起
words.core_image: 把音符一个个摆放到五线谱上，摆成一支曲子
examples: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
He composed a beautiful symphony.
semantic_expansions: 组成：com- 一起放 → 各部分放到一起成整体；创作/作曲：把音符/文字'摆放到一起'
words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pose（放置）→ 把部分放到一起 → 组成/创作

words.origin: ex-（向外）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to place something out in the open so it can be seen
words.core_concept: placing out into the open – 放置到外面让人看见
words.core_image: 把藏在幕布后的东西搬到阳光下展示出来
examples: The report exposed the scandal.
Don't expose your skin to the sun too long.
semantic_expansions: 暴露：ex- 向外放 → 放到外面让人看见
揭露：把秘密'放到明处'（expose a scandal）
使接触：使置于（阳光/风险）之中（expose to）
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ pose（放置）→ 放到外面 → 暴露/揭露

words.origin: pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to put an idea forward for consideration
words.core_concept: placing an idea forward – 把想法放到前面
words.core_image: 把方案放在桌上推到对方面前
examples: I propose we start early tomorrow.
He proposed to her on the beach.
semantic_expansions: 提议/建议：pro- 向前放 → 把想法放到对方面前；求婚：把心意'放到前面'说出口（propose to sb.）
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ pose（放置）→ 把想法放到前面 → 提议
words.recall_hint: pro-（向前）+ pose（放置）→ 把想法推到众人面前

words.origin: ob-（对着）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to place yourself against something
words.core_concept: placing against – 放到对立面
words.core_image: 两军面对面摆开阵势，立场相对
examples: Many residents oppose the new plan.
semantic_expansions: 反对/对抗：ob- 对着放 → 把自己放到对立面（op- 是 ob- 在 p 前的变体）
words.root_logic: op-（对着）+ pose（放置）→ 放到对立面 → 反对

words.origin: ad-（朝向）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to send someone in; to accept that something is true
words.core_concept: sending toward / letting in – 往里面送，放进来
words.core_image: 门口的人侧身放行让客人进来；把'这是真的'放进心里
examples: He admitted his mistake.
She was admitted to the university.
semantic_expansions: 准许进入：ad- 朝向 + mit 送 → 放行送进来；接纳：把（人/事）接入组织；承认：把（事实）'放进来'接受为真
words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ mit（送）→ 送进来 → 承认/准入

words.origin: com-（一起/完全）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to send yourself fully to something; to do something (often wrong)
words.core_concept: sending yourself entirely – 把自己整个交出去
words.core_image: 把全部的心力'送'给一件事，再也没有退路
examples: She committed herself to the project.
He committed a serious crime.
semantic_expansions: 承诺/投入：com- 完全 + mit 送 → 把自己完全'交出去'，没有退路
犯（错误/罪）：把（行为）完全'做出去'，完成一件（多为负面）事
words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ mit（送）→ 把自己完全送出去 → 承诺/投入

words.origin: per-（通过）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to let something pass; to allow
words.core_concept: sending through – 放行通过
words.core_image: 门卫挥手让车辆通过关卡
examples: Smoking is not permitted here.
You need a permit to park here.
semantic_expansions: 允许/许可：per- 通过 + mit 送 → 放行让通过；许可证：允许的书面凭证
words.root_logic: per-（通过）+ mit（送）→ 放行送过去 → 允许
words.recall_hint: per-（通过）+ mit（送）→ 让对方通过、放行

words.origin: trans-（跨越）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to send something across from one place or person to another
words.core_concept: sending across – 跨越距离送过去
words.core_image: 信号塔把电波跨越大山送到远方
examples: The disease is transmitted through water.
Data is transmitted over the network.
semantic_expansions: 传输/传送：trans- 跨越 + mit 送 → 跨越距离送过去；传播：（信息/疾病）送过人群
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ mit（送）→ 送过距离 → 传输

words.origin: 拉丁语 missio（送出的任务）
words.native_definition: a task that someone is sent to do; a group sent on a mission
words.core_concept: something sent out to be accomplished – 被派出去完成的任务
words.core_image: 一队人被派往远方，去完成交给他们的那件事
examples: The team completed its mission successfully.
semantic_expansions: 任务/使命：miss（送）+ -ion → 被'派送出去'要做的事
代表团：被派出的团体（trade mission 贸易代表团）
words.root_logic: miss（送）+ -ion（名词）→ 被送出去的任务 → 使命
words.recall_hint: mit（送）+ -ion → 被派出去要完成的那件事

words.origin: in-（往里）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: to look at something carefully and closely
words.core_concept: looking into details – 往里面仔细看
words.core_image: 质检员把产品拿近，仔细查看每个细节
examples: Officials inspected the factory for safety.
semantic_expansions: 检查/视察/审查：in- 往里 + spect 看 → 往内部仔细看；视察=上级往基层'看'；审查=带审视地检查
words.root_logic: in-（往里）+ spect（看）→ 往里仔细看 → 检查

words.origin: re-（反复）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: to look back at someone with high regard; admiration
words.core_concept: looking back with regard – 回望并给予重视
words.core_image: 面对值得敬重的人，目光里充满敬意地注视
examples: I respect her for her honesty.
In this respect, we agree.
semantic_expansions: 尊敬/尊重：re- 反复 + spect 看 → 因反复注视而心生敬意
方面：来自拉丁语 respectus（look back / regard），in this respect = 顺着这个看的角度 → 在这方面
words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ spect（看）→ 反复注视而生敬意 → 尊敬；'方面'义来自拉丁语 respectus（看的角度），见语义扩展
words.recall_hint: re-（反复）+ spect（看）→ 反复注视而生出的态度；也指看事情的某个角度

words.origin: pro-（向前）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: the possibility of what lies ahead; a view into the future
words.core_concept: looking forward – 向前看
words.core_image: 站在山顶向前眺望，远处隐约有值得走过去的东西
examples: The prospects for growth are good.
semantic_expansions: 前景：pro- 向前 + spect 看 → 向前看到的景象
可能性：对未来的预看（no prospect of success）
潜在客户：被视为'未来可期待'的客户（商业引申）
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ spect（看）→ 向前看的景象 → 前景

words.origin: 拉丁语 spectator（观看者）
words.native_definition: a person who watches an event
words.core_concept: one who looks – 观看的人
words.core_image: 看台上鼓掌呐喊的一群人，他们只是在看
examples: Thousands of spectators watched the match.
semantic_expansions: 观众/旁观者：spect（看）+ -ator（人）→ 观看的人；不参与、只观看的人=旁观者
words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -ator（人）→ 看的人 → 观众
words.recall_hint: spect（看）+ -ator（人）→ 做'看'这个动作的人

words.origin: ex-（向外）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: to look forward to something happening
words.core_concept: looking outward toward what will come – 向外看向将要到来的事
words.core_image: 站在门口向外张望，等待某人到来
examples: We expect the results tomorrow.
semantic_expansions: 期待/预料/指望：ex- 向外 + spect 看 → 目光向外看向将要到来的事；指望=期待并依赖
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 向外看向未来 → 期待

words.origin: de-（向下/完全）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: to write or say what something is like
words.core_concept: writing something down fully – 把所见完全写下来
words.core_image: 把看到的画面一笔一笔写下来让别人也能看见
examples: Can you describe the man you saw?
semantic_expansions: 描述/形容：de- 完全 + scrib 写 → 把所见'完整写下来'；形容=用语言描绘形状
words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ scrib（写）→ 完整写下来 → 描述
words.synonym_note: describe 描述细节；express 表达感情/想法；state 正式陈述

words.origin: pre-（预先）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: to write out a rule or a medical treatment in advance
words.core_concept: writing rules beforehand – 预先写下的规定
words.core_image: 医生在处方笺上预先写好用药方法
examples: The doctor prescribed antibiotics.
semantic_expansions: 开处方：pre- 预先 + scrib 写 → 医生预先写下的用药规定；规定/指示：预先写下的规则或指令
words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ scrib（写）→ 预先写下的规定 → 处方/规定

words.origin: trans-（跨越）+ scriptum（写下的东西）
words.native_definition: a written copy of what was said or recorded
words.core_concept: writing carried across – 把说过的话抄写转移过来
words.core_image: 把录音里的对话一字一字抄到纸上
examples: The court transcript was released.
She ordered her college transcript.
semantic_expansions: 文字记录：trans- 跨越 + script → 把口头的话'抄写'到纸面
成绩单：学业记录的副本（academic transcript）
抄本：手抄/复制的文本
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ script（写下的）→ 从原声抄写过来 → 记录/抄本

words.origin: manu-（手）+ scriptum（写下的）
words.native_definition: a book or document written by hand or typed before printing
words.core_concept: written by hand – 手写出来的东西
words.core_image: 中世纪僧侣伏案手抄经文的羊皮卷
examples: The author sent her manuscript to the publisher.
semantic_expansions: 手稿：manu- 手 + script 写 → 手写出来的文本；原稿：出版前的手写/打字稿
words.root_logic: manu-（手）+ script（写下的）→ 手写的 → 手稿

words.origin: sub-（在下面）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: to write your name at the bottom to agree or sign up
words.core_concept: writing your name underneath – 在下方签名表示同意
words.core_image: 在合同的底端签下自己的名字，表示自己站在下面认这份东西
examples: I subscribed to the channel.
He subscribed to the agreement.
semantic_expansions: 签署：sub- 在下面 + scrib 写 → 在文件下方签名
订阅：定期'签名确认'续订（subscribe to a channel）
赞成：签名表示同意（subscribe to a view）
words.root_logic: sub-（在下面）+ scrib（写）→ 在下方签名 → 订阅/赞同

words.origin: con-（一起）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to guide or lead; to carry out an activity
words.core_concept: leading together along a path – 带领着一起走
words.core_image: 站在乐团前的人挥动手中的棒，整支队伍跟着他往前走
examples: The experiment was conducted carefully.
He conducts the school orchestra.
semantic_expansions: 进行/实施：con- 一起 + duct 引导 → 带领整个流程走完
指挥：用引导棒带领乐团（conduct an orchestra）
行为：人引导自己的方式（conduct oneself）
words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ duct（引导）→ 带领整个流程 → 进行/指挥

words.origin: pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to bring something forward into existence
words.core_concept: leading forward into existence – 把事物引导出来
words.core_image: 工厂流水线把原料一步步引导成成品
examples: The factory produces cars.
The plan produced great results.
semantic_expansions: 生产/产生：pro- 向前 + duct 引导 → 把原料'引导'成成品
农产品：produce 作名词 → 被生产出来的东西（农场产品）
words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ duct（引导）→ 引导出来 → 生产

words.origin: intro-（向内）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to lead someone in; to make something known for the first time
words.core_concept: leading in – 把新事物引导进来
words.core_image: 主人把客人引到屋内，领着他见过在场的每个人
examples: Let me introduce my colleague.
The city introduced a new transport system.
semantic_expansions: 引进/推行：intro- 向内 + duct 引导 → 把新事物引导进来；介绍：把人'引'进来认识
words.root_logic: intro-（向内）+ duct（引导）→ 引导进来 → 介绍/引进

words.origin: e-（向外）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to lead someone out of ignorance into knowledge
words.core_concept: leading out – 把学习者从无知中引导出来
words.core_image: 老师像向导一样带着学生走出黑暗的房间，走进光明
examples: Schools educate children for the future.
semantic_expansions: 教育：e- 向外 + duc 引导 → 把人从无知中'引导出来'；培养：引导其成长
words.root_logic: e-（向外）+ duc（引导）→ 带出无知 → 教育

words.origin: re-（向后）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to lead something back to a smaller state
words.core_concept: leading back / down – 引导回更小的状态
words.core_image: 把水位引导回去，让水面降下来
examples: We must reduce our expenses.
semantic_expansions: 减少/降低/缩减：re- 往回 + duct 引导 → 引导回到更小的状态，三个译法同一概念
words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ duct（引导）→ 引导回更小 → 减少

words.origin: im-（向内）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: to carry goods into a country from abroad
words.core_concept: carrying in – 从外面运进来
words.core_image: 货轮把集装箱从国外运进港口
examples: The country imports most of its oil.
semantic_expansions: 进口：im- 向内 + port 运 → 从国外运进来
输入：把数据/货物运入
重要性：来自拉丁语 importare（带入分量）→ importance（注意：not直接由'运'变来）
words.root_logic: im-（向内）+ port（运送）→ 运进来 → 进口；'重要性'义来自拉丁语 importare（带入分量），见语义扩展
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ port（运送）→ 从外面运进来；引申为'有分量'

words.origin: ex-（向外）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: to carry goods out of a country for sale abroad
words.core_concept: carrying out – 运出去
words.core_image: 满载货物的轮船驶离港口开往国外
examples: They export rice to many countries.
semantic_expansions: 出口/输出：ex- 向外 + port 运 → 运出去
words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ port（运送）→ 运出去 → 出口

words.origin: trans-（跨越）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: to carry people or goods across a distance
words.core_concept: carrying across – 跨越距离运送
words.core_image: 卡车把货物从城市这头运到那头
examples: The goods were transported by rail.
semantic_expansions: 运输/运送：trans- 跨越 + port 运 → 跨越距离运送
交通工具：transport 作名词 → 运输所用的工具（public transport）
words.root_logic: trans-（跨越）+ port（运送）→ 运过距离 → 运输

words.origin: portare（运送）+ -able（能…的）
words.native_definition: able to be carried easily
words.core_concept: carriable – 能被带走的
words.core_image: 一个能轻松装进背包带走的设备
examples: This is a portable speaker.
semantic_expansions: port 运 + -able 能 → 能运的 → 便携的
words.root_logic: port（运送）+ -able（能…的）→ 能带走的 → 便携的

words.origin: re-（返回）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: to carry information back to someone
words.core_concept: carrying information back – 把信息带回去
words.core_image: 信使把前线的消息带回指挥部
examples: The journalist reported on the event.
Please report any problems to us.
semantic_expansions: 报告/汇报：re- 返回 + port 运 → 把消息'带回去'；报道：媒体把消息带回给公众
words.root_logic: re-（返回）+ port（运送）→ 把消息带回去 → 报告
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ port（运送）→ 把见到的消息带回来

words.origin: 古英语 ceosan（选择、挑选），与拉丁语 gustare（尝）同源
words.native_definition: to decide which one of several things you want
words.core_concept: deciding among options – 从多个候选中选定一个
words.core_image: 自助餐台上摆满菜品，你伸手端走最想吃的那一盘
examples: You can choose any course you like.
semantic_expansions: choose：最通用的'选择'，强调主观决定（choose to do）
引申：选定（choose a career）、愿意（do as you choose）
words.synonym_note: choose 最通用；select 强调按标准精心挑选；pick 口语化、随手挑
words.decomposable_note: 古英语 ceosan，与拉丁语 gustare（尝）远亲

words.origin: 拉丁语 seligere（挑选）：se-（分开）+ legere（收集、选择）
words.native_definition: to choose someone or something by thinking carefully about which is best
words.core_concept: choosing by careful standard – 按标准精心挑选
words.core_image: 评委在众多作品中仔细比较，挑出最优秀的那一件
examples: They selected him to lead the team.
semantic_expansions: se-（分开）+ legere（收集）→ 从收拢的一堆里分开挑出 → 挑选
形容词义'精选的'：selected works（精选作品）
words.synonym_note: select 强调按标准精心挑选；choose 更通用；pick 口语化

words.origin: 中古英语 piken（啄、摘取），拟声词源
words.native_definition: to choose something or someone from a group; to take something with your fingers
words.core_concept: taking one out by hand – 随手取出一个
words.core_image: 从果篮里随手拿起一个苹果
examples: Pick a card, any card.
semantic_expansions: 核心动作'用手取' → 挑一个（pick a card）、捡起（pick up）、采摘（pick apples）
words.synonym_note: pick 最口语化、随意；choose 通用；select 精心
words.decomposable_note: 中古英语 piken，拟声词源

words.root_logic: sta（立）本身即词根，无词缀 → 把话立在那里说明白；把事物立定的样子
words.origin: 拉丁语 status（站立的状态、状况）
words.native_definition: to say or write something clearly and formally
words.core_concept: putting something into words clearly – 把意思明确说出来
words.core_image: 在正式的场合，一字一句把立场说清楚
examples: Please state your name and address.
semantic_expansions: 动词义：明确说出（state the facts）；名词义'状态/国家'来自'站立的状态'（status）
words.synonym_note: state 正式、明确地陈述事实；express 表达感情/想法；describe 描述细节

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ press（压）→ 把某物或某人的状态往下压 → 压低 / 使低落
words.origin: 拉丁语 deprimere：de-（向下）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to push something down, or to make someone feel low in spirits
words.core_concept: forcing something to a lower level – 把某物压到更低的位置或状态
words.core_image: 一只手把弹起的琴键按到底，声音和高度一起沉下去
examples: Rainy weeks always depress him.
Depress the clutch before shifting gears.
The trade war depressed steel prices.
semantic_expansions: 按下（琴键/离合器）：物理上把东西压到低位，最直白的一层
压低（价格/产量）：把数值往下压，从物理位移引申到数量高低
使沮丧：把人的情绪压到低位——中文分成三个词，英文始终是同一个'往下压'的动作

words.root_logic: im-（上、之上）+ pose（放置）→ 把东西放到别人身上 → 强加
words.origin: 拉丁语 imponere：in-（在上）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to place something on someone by authority, often without their consent
words.core_concept: placing a burden onto someone from above – 自上而下把负担放到他人身上
words.core_image: 官员把一份沉重的文件压在对方桌上，对方没有推开的余地
examples: The government imposed a new tax on imports.
I don't want to impose on your weekend.
semantic_expansions: 强加/征收：把规则或税负放到对方身上，对方无从拒绝
打扰：把自己的需求放到别人的时间上——同样是'未经同意就放上去'，只是放的东西变成了麻烦

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ tract（拉）→ 从整体里拉走一部分 → 减损价值
words.origin: 拉丁语 detrahere：de-（拿走）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to take away from the value or quality of something
words.core_concept: pulling value away from something – 把价值从整体中拉走一部分
words.core_image: 一幅好画配了廉价画框，画框像在把画的档次往下拽
examples: One weak chapter does not detract from the book's overall value.
Cheap packaging detracts from the product's image.
semantic_expansions: 贬低/减损：都是把已有的价值往外拉走，区别只在拉的是名誉还是质量

words.root_logic: con-（一起、共同）+ form（形状）→ 让自己的形状与外部一致 → 遵从
words.origin: 拉丁语 conformare：con-（一起）+ formare（塑形）
words.native_definition: to behave according to a rule, standard, or the expectations of a group
words.core_concept: shaping oneself to match an external form – 把自己塑造成与外部标准相同的形状
words.core_image: 液体倒进模具，冷却后完全长成模具的形状
examples: All buildings must conform to the safety code.
He refused to conform to the group's expectations.
semantic_expansions: 符合（规范）：产品的形状与标准的形状重合
遵从/顺应（群体）：把自己的行为塑造成群体期待的形状——从物理同形引申到社会同形

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ tract（拉）→ 把已经伸出去的东西拉回来 → 收回
words.origin: 拉丁语 retrahere：re-（往回）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to pull something back in, or to take back a statement
words.core_concept: pulling back something already extended – 把已经伸出去的东西拉回原处
words.core_image: 猫把伸出的爪子藏进肉垫，痕迹留着但爪尖不见了
examples: The landing gear retracts after takeoff.
The newspaper retracted the false claim.
semantic_expansions: 缩回（起落架/爪子）：物理上把伸出的部件拉回
撤回（声明/指控）：把已经说出口的话拉回来——说出去的话被当作伸出去的东西

words.root_logic: o-（ob- 的变体，表'离开'）+ mit（送）→ 把某项送出集合之外 → 遗漏
words.origin: 拉丁语 omittere：ob-（离开）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to leave something out, either by choice or by mistake
words.core_concept: sending an item out of the set – 把某一项排到集合之外
words.core_image: 校对时用红笔把名单里的一行划掉，那一行从此不在名单上
examples: You can omit the second step if the file already exists.
She omitted her last job from the résumé.
semantic_expansions: 省略（有意）与遗漏（无意）：中文分两个词，英文是同一个动作——把它送出集合，区别只在是否故意

words.root_logic: sus-（sub- 的变体，表'从下面'）+ spect（看）→ 从下往上偷偷打量 → 怀疑
words.origin: 拉丁语 suspicere：sub-（从下）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: to believe something is likely, especially something bad, without proof
words.core_concept: looking at something from below with doubt – 从底下打量，觉得事情不对但没有证据
words.core_image: 海关人员低着头从下方斜眼打量旅客的行李，什么都没说
examples: Police suspect the fire was deliberate.
I suspect she already knows.
semantic_expansions: 怀疑（动词）：从下往上打量，看出可疑但拿不出证据
嫌疑人（名词）：被这样打量的那个人——同一个'被审视'的画面，只是视角从看的人转到被看的人

words.root_logic: de-（从…向下）+ duc（引导）→ 从已知前提一路引下来 → 推断出结论
words.origin: 拉丁语 deducere：de-（从…下来）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to reach a conclusion by reasoning from known facts
words.core_concept: leading a conclusion down from known premises – 从已知前提把结论一路引出来
words.core_image: 侦探把桌上的线索用红线一根根牵到墙上同一个名字
examples: From the muddy footprints we can deduce he came through the garden.
She deduced the password from his birthday.
semantic_expansions: 推断与演绎：同一个动作的两种说法——顺着已知的线往下牵，牵到终点就是结论

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ port（运送）→ 把人运离这个国家 → 驱逐出境
words.origin: 拉丁语 deportare：de-（离开）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: to force a person to leave a country, usually to their country of origin
words.core_concept: carrying a person out of the country – 把人从这个国家运出去
words.core_image: 两名警员押着一个人走上舷梯，登机口在身后关上
examples: He was deported after his visa expired.
The court ordered her to be deported.
semantic_expansions: 驱逐出境与遣送：都是把人当作要运走的对象送出边界，区别只在语气轻重

words.root_logic: a-（ad- 的变体，表'朝向'）+ scrib（写）→ 把某事写到某人名下 → 归因于
words.origin: 拉丁语 ascribere：ad-（朝向）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: to say that something was caused by or belongs to a particular person or thing
words.core_concept: writing something into someone's account – 把某件事记到某人名下
words.core_image: 会计把一笔支出写进某个人的账目那一栏
examples: Historians ascribe the collapse to poor harvests.
The poem is usually ascribed to an anonymous monk.
semantic_expansions: 归因于（原因）与归于（作者）：都是把某样东西写进某人的账，只是记的是责任还是署名

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ press（压）→ 把要冒出来的东西压回去 → 压制
words.origin: 拉丁语 reprimere：re-（往回）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to hold back a feeling, memory, or action so it cannot come out
words.core_concept: pushing back something trying to surface – 把想冒出来的东西压回去
words.core_image: 水面下的皮球被一只手一直按着，不让它浮上来
examples: He repressed the urge to laugh.
The regime repressed all public protest.
semantic_expansions: 压抑（情绪）与镇压（民众）：都是把正在往上冒的东西按回去，区别只在按的是感受还是人群

words.root_logic: express（往外压）+ -ion（名词后缀）→ 被压出来的那个东西 → 表情 / 表达 / 表达式
words.origin: 拉丁语 expressio：ex-（向外）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: the act of showing thoughts or feelings, or the form in which they appear
words.core_concept: what has been pressed outward into visible form – 被压到外面、变得可见的那个结果
words.core_image: 颜料从软管里被挤出来，落在纸上成为看得见的形状
examples: Freedom of expression is protected by law.
A puzzled expression crossed her face.
This expression evaluates to zero.
semantic_expansions: 表达：把内心的想法压到外面，成为别人能接收的形式
表情：压到脸上的那一层——情绪外化成可见的样子
表达式（数学/编程）：把一段意思压成一个可求值的写法。三个中文词对应同一个'被压出来的形式'
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ press（压）+ -ion → 被压到外面、变得看得见的那个形式

words.root_logic: op-（ob- 的变体，表'对着、压向'）+ press（压）→ 长期压在某人身上 → 压迫
words.origin: 拉丁语 opprimere：ob-（对着）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: to treat people cruelly and unfairly by keeping them under control
words.core_concept: keeping someone down by constant weight – 用持续的重量把人压在下面
words.core_image: 一块石板长年压在人的背上，人始终直不起身
examples: The colonial system oppressed millions.
The silence in the room oppressed him.
semantic_expansions: 压迫（制度对人）与使沉重（气氛对心）：都是有重量长期压着，区别在压的是身体还是心情

words.root_logic: form（形成）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 成形的过程，或成形后的排列 → 形成 / 队形
words.origin: 拉丁语 formatio：formare（塑形）
words.native_definition: the process of coming into existence, or an arranged pattern of things
words.core_concept: the act of taking shape, or the shape taken – 成形的过程，或成形的结果
words.core_image: 雁群在天空中逐渐排成一个人字形
examples: The formation of ice begins at the surface.
The jets flew in tight formation.
Rock formations line the canyon wall.
semantic_expansions: 形成：强调从无到有取得形状的过程
队形/构造：强调取得形状之后的那个排列。同一个'成形'，一个看过程一个看结果
words.recall_hint: form（成形）+ -ation → 取得形状的过程，或取得形状后的那个排列

words.root_logic: inform（让信息在脑中成形）+ -ation → 让认知成形的那些内容 → 信息
words.origin: 拉丁语 informatio：in-（进入）+ formare（塑形）
words.native_definition: facts or details that shape what someone knows about something
words.core_concept: content that gives shape to someone's knowledge – 在人脑中把认知塑造成形的内容
words.core_image: 散落的碎片进入脑中，逐渐拼成一幅清晰的图
examples: We need more information before deciding.
The leaflet contains information about opening hours.
semantic_expansions: 信息与资料：都是能让人脑中的认知成形的内容，区别只在是否已被整理

words.root_logic: uni-（一个）+ form（形状）→ 全体只有一种形状 → 统一的 / 制服
words.origin: 拉丁语 uniformis：unus（一）+ forma（形状）
words.native_definition: the same in every part or case; also a set of identical clothes for a group
words.core_concept: having one single shape throughout – 通体只有一种形状，没有差异
words.core_image: 一排学生穿着完全相同的外套站在操场上
examples: Apply uniform pressure across the surface.
Students must wear school uniform.
semantic_expansions: 统一的/一致的：形状处处相同，没有变化
制服（名词）：让一群人外形统一的那套衣服——从'同一种形状'落到具体的物

words.root_logic: abs-（ab- 的变体，表'离开'）+ tract（拉）→ 把本质从具体事物里拉出来 → 抽象的 / 摘要
words.origin: 拉丁语 abstrahere：ab-（离开）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing; also a short summary of a text
words.core_concept: pulled away from concrete instances – 从具体事物中被抽离出来的那部分
words.core_image: 从一堆苹果、橘子里把'水果'这个概念单独拎出来，手里却什么都没有
examples: Justice is an abstract concept.
Read the abstract before the full paper.
semantic_expansions: 抽象的：把共性从具体事物里拉出来，剩下的就是概念
摘要（名词）：把论文要点拉出来的那一段。中文分成两个词，英文是同一个'抽离'动作

words.root_logic: sub-（从下面）+ tract（拉）→ 从总量下面抽走一部分 → 减去
words.origin: 拉丁语 subtrahere：sub-（从下）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: to take one number or amount away from another
words.core_concept: pulling an amount out of a total – 从总量里抽走一部分
words.core_image: 从一叠钞票的底下抽走几张，整叠明显变薄
examples: Subtract the deposit from the total price.
If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.

words.root_logic: attract（拉向自己）+ -ion → 那股把人拉过来的力，或产生这股力的东西 → 吸引力 / 景点
words.origin: 拉丁语 attractio：ad-（朝向）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: the force that draws people or things toward something, or a place people are drawn to
words.core_concept: the pull that draws things toward a center – 把事物拉向某处的那股力量
words.core_image: 磁铁周围的铁屑全部朝它排列过去
examples: Gravity is a force of attraction.
The castle is the town's main attraction.
semantic_expansions: 吸引力/魅力：那股把人或物拉过来的力本身
景点：因为这股力而被人涌向的那个地方——从力引申到力的来源

words.root_logic: tract（拉）+ -ion → 拉动这件事本身，即拉得住的能力 → 牵引力 / 抓地力
words.origin: 拉丁语 tractio：trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: the grip that lets a surface pull without slipping; also the progress an idea starts to gain
words.core_concept: the ability to pull without slipping – 拉得动而不打滑的那种咬合力
words.core_image: 轮胎花纹咬住湿滑路面，车稳稳往前拉走
examples: Snow tyres give better traction on ice.
The proposal is finally gaining traction.
semantic_expansions: 牵引力/抓地力：物理上咬住地面往前拉的能力
进展：一个想法开始'咬住'现实、能往前推动——同一个'咬得住才拉得动'的画面

words.root_logic: de-（脱离、破坏）+ form（形状）→ 使脱离原本的形状 → 使变形
words.origin: 拉丁语 deformare：de-（去除）+ formare（塑形）
words.native_definition: to change something's shape so that it is no longer correct or normal
words.core_concept: forcing something out of its proper shape – 把东西挤出它本来的形状
words.core_image: 铝罐被一脚踩下，侧面凹进去再也回不去
examples: Heat can deform plastic parts.
The impact deformed the door frame.
semantic_expansions: 使变形与损坏外形：都是让物体离开它应有的形状，程度不同而已

words.root_logic: compress（一起压）+ -ion → 被压紧这件事，或压紧的程度 → 压缩
words.origin: 拉丁语 compressio：com-（一起）+ premere（压）
words.native_definition: the act of pressing something into a smaller space, or the state of being pressed
words.core_concept: the state of being pressed into less space – 被压进更小空间的那个状态
words.core_image: 真空袋抽气后，蓬松的被子塌成薄薄一片
examples: Image compression reduces file size.
The engine's compression ratio is high.
semantic_expansions: 压缩（文件）与压紧（气体）：都是把同样的内容压进更小的空间，区别只在压的对象
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ press（压）+ -ion → 被压进更小空间的那个状态

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ pose（放置）→ 把东西分开放好，或放到别处去 → 处理 / 处置
words.origin: 拉丁语 disponere：dis-（分开）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to get rid of something, or to arrange things in a particular order
words.core_concept: placing things apart into their proper place – 把东西分开安置到该去的地方
words.core_image: 把桌上的东西一件件分类放进不同抽屉，桌面清空
examples: Please dispose of the packaging responsibly.
The troops were disposed along the ridge.
semantic_expansions: 布置：把东西分开摆到各自位置上
处理/处置：把东西放到'不在这里'的位置去，即丢弃。同一个'分开安置'，区别在放到哪儿

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，表'在下面'）+ pose（放置）→ 先在底下垫一个前提 → 假定
words.origin: 拉丁语 supponere：sub-（在下）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to think something is probably true, or to take it as a starting assumption
words.core_concept: placing an assumption underneath as a base – 在推理底下先垫一个前提
words.core_image: 搭台子前先在底下塞一块砖，整个台面靠它撑着
examples: Suppose the train is late — what then?
I suppose you're right.
semantic_expansions: 假定：明确在底下垫一个前提，用来往下推
认为/料想：口语里把这个'垫底的判断'说得轻一些，实质仍是未经证实的前提

words.root_logic: compose（放在一起）+ -ition → 放在一起的方式，或放好的成品 → 构成 / 作品
words.origin: 拉丁语 compositio：com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the way parts are put together, or a piece of writing or music that results
words.core_concept: how parts are placed together – 各部分被放在一起的方式，及其成品
words.core_image: 摄影师在取景框里挪动每个元素，直到画面各就各位
examples: The composition of the soil affects growth.
She wrote a composition about her hometown.
The photograph's composition draws the eye upward.
semantic_expansions: 构成/构图：强调各部分被放在一起的那种方式
作文/作曲：把词句或音符放在一起得到的成品。同一个'放在一起'，一个指方式一个指结果

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ mit（送）→ 把东西往上级下方送去 → 提交 / 服从
words.origin: 拉丁语 submittere：sub-（在下）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to hand something in for consideration, or to yield to a stronger force
words.core_concept: sending something under another's authority – 把东西或自己送到对方权威之下
words.core_image: 把文件双手递到柜台后的人手里，决定权就此交出去
examples: Please submit your application before Friday.
The rebels refused to submit.
semantic_expansions: 提交：把材料送到对方那里，由对方裁决
服从/屈服：把自己送到对方权威之下。同一个'送到下方'，区别只在送的是文件还是自己

words.root_logic: dis-（离开）+ miss（送）→ 把人送走 → 解散 / 解雇 / 不予考虑
words.origin: 拉丁语 dimittere：dis-（离开）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to send someone away, or to refuse to take an idea seriously
words.core_concept: sending someone or something away from here – 把人或念头送离此处
words.core_image: 老师一挥手，整班学生起身离开教室
examples: The teacher dismissed the class early.
He was dismissed for repeated absences.
The judge dismissed the case.
semantic_expansions: 解散/解雇：把人送出这个场所或岗位
驳回：把一个主张送出考虑范围。三个中文词共享'送走、不留在这里'这一个动作

words.root_logic: permit（让…通过）+ -sion → 允许通过这件事本身 → 许可
words.origin: 拉丁语 permissio：per-（通过）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: official agreement that lets someone do something
words.core_concept: the act of letting something pass through – 放行这件事本身
words.core_image: 闸口抬起横杆，车辆得以通过
examples: You need written permission to enter the site.
She gave permission for the photo to be used.
semantic_expansions: 许可与允许：都是把横杆抬起来让对方通过，区别只在是否落成书面形式
words.recall_hint: per-（通过）+ mit（送）+ -ion → 放行这件事本身

words.root_logic: a-（ad- 的变体，表'朝向'）+ spect（看）→ 朝某个方向看到的那一面 → 方面
words.origin: 拉丁语 aspectus：ad-（朝向）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: one of the sides or features of something being considered
words.core_concept: the face something shows from one viewing angle – 从某个角度看过去所呈现的那一面
words.core_image: 同一座山，从东面看是峭壁，从南面看是缓坡
examples: We must consider every aspect of the plan.
The room has a southern aspect.
semantic_expansions: 方面：从某个角度审视一件事时露出的那一面
朝向/外观：建筑面朝哪边，即它把哪一面呈现给你看。同一个'从某方向看到的面'

words.root_logic: per-（透过）+ spect（看）→ 透过某个位置看出去的整体样子 → 视角 / 透视
words.origin: 拉丁语 perspicere：per-（透过）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: a particular way of viewing things, or the technique of showing depth on a flat surface
words.core_concept: the whole view obtained from one standpoint – 站在某一点看出去所得到的整体图景
words.core_image: 站在铁轨中央，两条平行线在远处收成一个点
examples: From a historian's perspective, the treaty changed little.
The drawing uses one-point perspective.
semantic_expansions: 透视法：绘画上把三维深度画到平面上的技法，直接对应'透过一点看出去'
视角/观点：把这个站位从物理位置引申为立场，看到的图景随之不同

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -acle（表工具或对象）→ 值得看的那个东西 → 壮观场面
words.origin: 拉丁语 spectaculum：spectare（观看）
words.native_definition: an impressive or unusual sight that people gather to watch
words.core_concept: something staged to be watched – 专门摆出来供人观看的场面
words.core_image: 广场上焰火升空，人群齐齐仰头
examples: The opening ceremony was a spectacle.
He polished his spectacles on his sleeve.
semantic_expansions: 壮观场面/奇观：被摆出来让人看的那个对象
眼镜（复数 spectacles）：用来看的那个器具——同一个词根落到工具上，这是独立引申的一支

words.root_logic: propose（往前放）+ -al → 被放到台面上的那个方案 → 提议
words.origin: 拉丁语 proponere：pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a plan or suggestion put forward for others to consider
words.core_concept: what has been placed forward for consideration – 被推到台面上供人评议的那个东西
words.core_image: 会议桌上被推到中间的那份文件，所有人都看得见
examples: The committee rejected the proposal.
She accepted his proposal.
semantic_expansions: 提议/方案：被推到众人面前等待评议的内容
求婚：把终身大事推到对方面前等一个答复——同样是'放到前面等回应'

words.root_logic: transmit（送过去）+ -sion → 送过去这件事，或负责送的那套装置 → 传输 / 变速箱
words.origin: 拉丁语 transmissio：trans-（穿过）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: the act of sending something across a distance, or the part that carries power to the wheels
words.core_concept: the passing of something across a gap – 把某物从这一端送到那一端
words.core_image: 信号沿着电缆一路传到对岸的接收站
examples: Data transmission slows during peak hours.
Masks reduce transmission of the virus.
The car's transmission needs repair.
semantic_expansions: 传输/传播：把数据或病毒从一端送到另一端
变速箱：把发动机动力送到车轮的那套机构——从'送'这个动作引申为承担送的装置

words.root_logic: respect（回头看）+ -ive → 逐个回头看清各自对应的那个 → 各自的
words.origin: 拉丁语 respectivus：re-（回）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: belonging separately to each of the people or things mentioned
words.core_concept: looking back at each one separately – 逐个回看，把各自对应的关系分清
words.core_image: 颁奖后各人拿着自己那一份奖状回到各自座位
examples: After the meeting they returned to their respective offices.
The two firms kept their respective logos.
semantic_expansions: 各自的与分别的：都是逐个回看、把对应关系一一分清，中文两种译法对应同一个动作

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ scrib（写、刻）→ 把字刻进材料里 → 铭刻
words.origin: 拉丁语 inscribere：in-（进入）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: to cut or write words into a surface so they last
words.core_concept: cutting words into a surface to last – 把文字刻进表面，使其长久留存
words.core_image: 石匠在墓碑上一锤一凿刻下名字
examples: His name is inscribed on the memorial.
She inscribed a message inside the book cover.
semantic_expansions: 铭刻与题写：都是把字留进载体里，区别只在刻的是石头还是纸页

words.root_logic: describe（把轮廓写下来）+ -tion → 写下来的那段轮廓 → 描述
words.origin: 拉丁语 descriptio：de-（往下）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: an account in words that lets someone picture what something is like
words.core_concept: words that trace the outline of something – 用文字把某物的轮廓勾出来
words.core_image: 画像师听着口述，在纸上一点点勾出嫌疑人的脸
examples: The police issued a description of the suspect.
Read the product description before ordering.
semantic_expansions: 描述与说明：都是用文字勾出对象的轮廓，区别在侧重外形还是用法

words.root_logic: prescribe（事先写下）+ -tion → 事先写好的那张指令 → 处方
words.origin: 拉丁语 praescriptio：prae-（在前）+ scribere（写）
words.native_definition: a written instruction from a doctor for medicine, or any prescribed course of action
words.core_concept: an instruction written down in advance – 事先写下、要求照办的那份指令
words.core_image: 医生撕下一张单子递过来，药房照着上面抓药
examples: This medicine requires a prescription.
There is no simple prescription for economic growth.
semantic_expansions: 处方/药方：医生事先写下、要求照办的那张纸
规定：把'事先写好、照此执行'从医嘱扩到一般做法上

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ duc（引导）→ 把人或状态引入某处 → 诱导 / 引发
words.origin: 拉丁语 inducere：in-（进入）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to persuade someone into an action, or to cause a state to begin
words.core_concept: leading something into a new state – 把人或事引入某个状态
words.core_image: 牵着马的缰绳，一步步把它引进马厩
examples: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
The drug induces drowsiness.
semantic_expansions: 诱导/促使（对人）：把人引进某个决定
引发（对状态）：把某个状态引进来。同一个'牵引入内'，区别只在被引的是人还是现象

words.root_logic: produce（往前引出）+ -tion → 把东西引出来这件事，或引出的成品 → 生产 / 作品
words.origin: 拉丁语 productio：pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: the process of making things, or a work created for stage or screen
words.core_concept: the act of bringing something forth – 把东西引到世上来的过程及其成果
words.core_image: 流水线尽头，成品一件件被推出车间大门
examples: Steel production fell last quarter.
The theatre's new production opens tonight.
semantic_expansions: 生产/产量：把东西引到世上来的过程和数量
作品（戏剧/影视）：被搬上台面的那个成品——同样是'被引出来示于人前'

words.root_logic: conduct（引导）+ -or（施动者）→ 负责引导的那个人或物 → 指挥 / 导体
words.origin: 拉丁语 conductor：com-（一起）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: a person who leads an orchestra or takes fares, or a material that carries current
words.core_concept: whatever leads something along a path – 负责把某物沿路引导过去的人或物
words.core_image: 棒子一起一落，整个乐队跟着走；铜线里电流也顺着一路通过
examples: The conductor raised his baton.
Copper is an excellent conductor.
Show your ticket to the conductor.
semantic_expansions: 指挥：引导乐队走完整首曲子的那个人
导体：引导电流通过的那种材料
售票员：在车厢里引导乘客的那个人。三个中文词共享'负责引导'这一个身份

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，表'从下面'）+ port（承载）→ 从下面把重量担起来 → 支撑 / 支持
words.origin: 拉丁语 supportare：sub-（从下）+ portare（运送、承载）
words.native_definition: to hold something up from below, or to help and back someone
words.core_concept: bearing weight from underneath – 从底下把重量担住，使其不塌
words.core_image: 几根立柱托住整个屋顶，屋顶因此不落下来
examples: Four pillars support the roof.
Most members support the proposal.
He supports a family of five.
semantic_expansions: 支撑（物理）：从下面担住重量
支持（立场）：在背后担住对方的主张
赡养：担起一个家的开销。三层意思都是'在底下把重量接住'

words.root_logic: im-（in- 的变体，表'进入'）+ port（运送）→ 分量重到被运进来的 → 重要的
words.origin: 拉丁语 importare：in-（进入）+ portare（运送）——原义'带进来'，引申为'有分量的'
words.native_definition: having great value or effect, so it must not be ignored
words.core_concept: carrying enough weight to matter – 分量足够大，无法被忽略
words.core_image: 一个箱子沉得需要两个人抬，谁都不能视而不见
examples: This is an important decision.
It is important to arrive on time.
semantic_expansions: 重要的与重大的：同一个'有分量、搬不动'的画面，中文按程度分了两个词

words.root_logic: transport（运过去）+ -ation → 运送这件事，或用来运送的系统 → 运输
words.origin: 拉丁语 transportare：trans-（穿过）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: the moving of people or goods, or the system that does this
words.core_concept: the carrying of things across a distance – 把人或物跨距离运走这件事
words.core_image: 货运列车载满集装箱驶过平原
examples: Public transportation is free on Sundays.
Transportation of fuel requires a permit.
semantic_expansions: 运输：把货物跨距离运走的行为
交通/交通工具：承担这件事的整套系统。同一个'运送'，一个指行为一个指系统
words.recall_hint: trans-（穿过）+ port（运送）+ -ation → 跨距离运送这件事，或承担它的系统

words.root_logic: fig（塑形、捏造）+ -ment（结果）→ 被捏出来的东西 → 虚构之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 figmentum：fingere（塑造、捏造）
words.native_definition: something imagined that has no basis in reality
words.core_concept: a form shaped only in the mind – 只在脑中捏出来的形状，现实里没有对应
words.core_image: 空手在空气里捏出一个形状，松手什么都不剩
examples: The noise was a figment of his imagination.
Those threats were pure figment.
semantic_expansions: 虚构之物与臆想：都是脑中捏出形状但现实无对应，中文一个偏结果一个偏过程

words.root_logic: report（把消息带回）+ -er（施动者）→ 负责把消息带回来的人 → 记者
words.origin: 拉丁语 reportare：re-（回）+ portare（运送）
words.native_definition: someone whose job is to gather news and bring it back to the public
words.core_concept: the person who carries news back – 负责把现场消息运回给公众的人
words.core_image: 从灾区带着录音和照片赶回编辑部的那个人
examples: A reporter asked the minister two questions.
She works as a reporter for a local paper.
semantic_expansions: 记者与通讯员：都是把消息从现场运回来的人，区别只在隶属关系

words.root_logic: ab-（离开）+ duct（引导、带走）→ 强行把人带离原处 → 绑架
words.origin: 拉丁语 abducere：ab-（离开）+ ducere（引导）
words.native_definition: to take someone away by force
words.core_concept: leading a person away against their will – 违背意愿把人从原处带走
words.core_image: 面包车停下，人被拽上车后车门关上
examples: Two men attempted to abduct the child.
She was abducted near the station.
semantic_expansions: 绑架与劫走：都是违背对方意愿把人带离原处，中文按场合分了两个词

words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -ment（结果）→ 被立在那里、供人查看的一份东西 → 陈述、报表
words.origin: 拉丁语 stare（站立）经古法语 estat 进入英语
words.native_definition: something said or written clearly and officially, or a record of accounts
words.core_concept: something set down and left standing for others to check – 把话或账立在那里供人核对
words.core_image: 银行把一张对账单摊在柜台上，数字一行行立在纸面
examples: The minister issued a short statement.
Check your bank statement each month.
semantic_expansions: 陈述/声明：把话立在众人面前，立了就不能随口改
报表：把账目立成一份可核对的记录。中文分两个词，英文是同一个'立在那里供查'

words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -tion（名词）→ 固定站住的那个点 → 站、台、岗位
words.origin: 拉丁语 statio：stare（站立）的名词形式
words.native_definition: a fixed place where something stops or where someone is posted
words.core_concept: a fixed point where things come to a stop – 一个固定不动、供人物停靠的点
words.core_image: 月台立在原地，列车来了又走，它始终没动
examples: The train pulls into the station at noon.
He was posted to a remote station.
semantic_expansions: 车站：车流动而站不动，这是最直白的一层
电台/岗位：同样是固定不动的据点，只是停靠的是信号或人

words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -ic（形容词）→ 立着不动的 → 静止的
words.origin: 希腊语 statikos ← 与拉丁语 stare 同源的印欧词根
words.native_definition: not moving or changing; also unwanted noise in a signal
words.core_concept: staying in place without change – 停在原处不动、不变
words.core_image: 收音机指针一动不动，喇叭里只剩沙沙的底噪
examples: House prices remained static all year.
The radio gave off nothing but static.
semantic_expansions: 静止的：立着不动，最本义的一层
静电：电荷停在物体表面不流动
杂音：信号里不流动的那层底噪。三个中文词共享'不流动'这一个画面

words.root_logic: station（固定的点）+ -ary（属于…的）→ 属于那个固定点的 → 不动的
words.origin: 拉丁语 stationarius：statio（站立处）的形容词形式
words.native_definition: not moving from one place
words.core_concept: held at one point, not travelling – 停在一个点上不移动
words.core_image: 堵车时整排车停着不走，发动机还响着
examples: The traffic was stationary for an hour.
Keep the camera stationary while filming.
semantic_expansions: 不动的与静止的：中文两种译法，英文都是'钉在那个点上没走'

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stit（sta 的变体，立）+ -ution → 在社会里立起来的东西 → 机构、制度
words.origin: 拉丁语 institutio：in-（进入）+ statuere（使立起，源自 stare）
words.native_definition: an established organization, or an established custom or law
words.core_concept: something set up and left standing in society – 在社会中立起来并延续下去的东西
words.core_image: 一栋石砌大楼立在城中，几代人换了它还在
examples: The bank is one of the country's oldest institutions.
Marriage is a social institution.
semantic_expansions: 机构：立在社会里的那个实体组织
制度/惯例：立起来并被延续的做法。同一个'立起来就留着'，一个是实体一个是规则

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stit（立）+ -ution → 把各部分一起立成一个整体 → 构成、宪法、体质
words.origin: 拉丁语 constitutio：con-（一起）+ statuere（使立起）
words.native_definition: the way something is made up, or the fundamental law by which a state is governed
words.core_concept: how the parts are set up to stand together – 各部分被一起立成整体的方式
words.core_image: 一部法典摊在桌上，国家的骨架就照它立起来
examples: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
semantic_expansions: 宪法：国家骨架据以立起来的那份根本法
构成：各部分立成整体的方式
体质：人这副身体被立起来的底子。三个中文词都指'立成整体的构造'
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ stit（立）+ -ution → 各部分被一起立成整体的方式，及据以立起的根本法

words.root_logic: con-（一起、完全）+ clud（关闭）→ 把事情完全关上 → 结束、下结论
words.origin: 拉丁语 concludere：con-（一起）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to bring something to an end, or to decide after considering the facts
words.core_concept: shutting a matter for good – 把一件事关上，不再敞着
words.core_image: 法官合上卷宗，庭审到此为止
examples: The meeting concluded at five.
Police concluded that the fire was accidental.
The two sides concluded a trade deal.
semantic_expansions: 结束：把事情关上不再敞着
得出结论：把思考关上，落定一个说法
缔结（条约）：把谈判关上并定案。三层都是'合上、不再开着'
words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ clud（关闭）→ 把一件事彻底合上

words.root_logic: ex-（在外）+ clud（关闭）→ 把某物关在门外 → 排除
words.origin: 拉丁语 excludere：ex-（外）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something out, or to leave it out of a group
words.core_concept: shutting something outside the boundary – 把某物关在界线之外
words.core_image: 门在来人面前合上，他被留在门外
examples: The price excludes delivery.
She felt excluded from the group.
semantic_expansions: 不包括（价格）：把这一项关在范围之外
排斥在外（人）：把人关在圈子之外。同一个'关在外面'，区别只在被关的是项目还是人

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ clud（关闭）→ 把某物关进范围之内 → 包含
words.origin: 拉丁语 includere：in-（内）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to have something as part of a whole
words.core_concept: shutting something inside the boundary – 把某物关进界线之内
words.core_image: 把一件东西放进箱子再合盖，它从此算箱内之物
examples: The price includes breakfast.
The team includes two new players.
semantic_expansions: 包括与包含：都是把某物关在范围之内，中文两种译法对应同一个动作

words.root_logic: exclude（关在外）+ -ive（倾向于…的）→ 惯于把别人关在外面的 → 独家的、排他的
words.origin: 拉丁语 exclusivus：ex-（外）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: limited to one person or group and shut off from others
words.core_concept: keeping others shut out – 把其他人一律关在门外
words.core_image: 会所门口只放持卡人进去，其余人一律拦在外面
examples: The magazine ran an exclusive interview.
It is an exclusive club with a long waiting list.
semantic_expansions: 独家的：其他媒体被关在外面，只有我有
高档的：普通人被关在外面，因而显得贵。同一个'把别人关在外面'落到不同场合

words.root_logic: se-（分开）+ clud（关闭）→ 单独关起来 → 隔离、隐居
words.origin: 拉丁语 secludere：se-（分开）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something away from other people
words.core_concept: shutting someone apart from others – 把人单独关开，断了往来
words.core_image: 山间独院，门一关就与外界断了往来
examples: She secluded herself in a mountain cabin to write.
The monastery secludes its novices for a year.
semantic_expansions: 隔离与隐居：都是单独关开、断绝往来，区别只在是否出于自愿

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tain（握住）→ 把东西一起握在里面 → 容纳、控制住
words.origin: 拉丁语 continere：con-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to hold something inside, or to keep something under control
words.core_concept: holding contents together within bounds – 把内容一起握在界限之内
words.core_image: 双手捧住一堆沙，手一松就散
examples: This bottle contains two litres.
Firefighters contained the blaze by dawn.
semantic_expansions: 包含/容纳：把内容握在里面不让它散出去
控制（火势/疫情）：把它握在界限内不让扩散。同一个'握住不放它出去'
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tain（握住）→ 把内容一起握在界限之内

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向、对着）+ tain（握住）→ 伸手够到并握住 → 获得
words.origin: 拉丁语 obtinere：ob-（朝向）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to get something, especially by effort or by asking
words.core_concept: reaching out and getting hold of something – 伸手过去把东西握到手里
words.core_image: 隔着柜台把证件递过来，手一合就攥住了
examples: You must obtain written permission first.
The data was obtained from public records.
semantic_expansions: 获得与取得：都是伸手把东西握到手里，中文两种译法对应同一个动作

words.root_logic: re-（往回、持续）+ tain（握住）→ 一直握着不放 → 保留
words.origin: 拉丁语 retinere：re-（往回）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep something and not lose or give it up
words.core_concept: continuing to hold what one already has – 已经握着的继续不放
words.core_image: 水从指缝流走，手却仍攥着最后那一把
examples: The company retained all its staff through the downturn.
Sandy soil does not retain water.
She retains a clear memory of that night.
semantic_expansions: 保留/保持：握着的不松手
记住：把信息握在脑中不让它流走。同一个'不松手'，握的东西从实物变成记忆

words.root_logic: de-（离开原路）+ tain（握住）→ 把人从原本要去的路上握住 → 扣留、耽误
words.origin: 拉丁语 detinere：de-（离开）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep someone from leaving, officially or by delay
words.core_concept: holding someone back from going on – 把要走的人握住不让走
words.core_image: 机场安检把人拦下带进小房间，航班还在等
examples: Two suspects were detained for questioning.
Sorry to detain you — this will only take a minute.
semantic_expansions: 拘留（警方）：正式把人握住不放走
耽误（日常）：把人留住让他走不了。同一个'握住不让走'，区别只在有无强制力

words.root_logic: sus-（sub- 的变体，从下面）+ tain（握住）→ 从底下托住不让塌 → 维持
words.origin: 拉丁语 sustinere：sub-（从下）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep something going over time, or to bear the weight of it
words.core_concept: holding something up from below so it lasts – 从下面托住，使它持续不塌
words.core_image: 一只手在下面托住摇摇欲坠的书堆，手不撤书就不倒
examples: The economy cannot sustain this rate of growth.
The roof sustained heavy snow all winter.
semantic_expansions: 支撑/承受：从底下托住重量
维持（增长/生命）：从底下托住让它继续。同一个'托住不让塌'，一个是物理重量一个是过程

words.root_logic: pre-（在…之前）+ clud（关闭）→ 事情发生前先把门关上 → 预先排除
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecludere：prae-（在前）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to make something impossible in advance
words.core_concept: shutting the door before something can happen – 在事情发生前先把路关掉
words.core_image: 闸门在洪水到来之前就已落下，水根本进不来
examples: His injury precludes any chance of competing.
The contract precludes further claims.
semantic_expansions: 排除与阻止：都是提前把门关上让事情无从发生，区别只在语气强弱

words.root_logic: include（关在内）+ -ive（倾向于…的）→ 惯于把人一起关在内的 → 包容的、含…在内的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inclusivus：in-（内）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: containing everything mentioned, or open to everyone
words.core_concept: keeping everyone and everything inside the boundary – 把所有人和项都关在范围之内
words.core_image: 圈子画得很大，所有人都被圈在里面，没人留在外头
examples: The price is inclusive of tax.
The school has an inclusive admissions policy.
semantic_expansions: 包含在内的（价格）：项目被关在范围之内
包容的（政策）：人被关在圈子之内。同一个'都圈在里面'，一个对物一个对人

words.root_logic: af-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ fect（fac 的变体，做）→ 对某物做点什么，使它起变化 → 影响
words.origin: 拉丁语 afficere：ad-（朝向）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to produce a change in someone or something
words.core_concept: doing something to a thing so that it changes – 对某物施加动作，使它发生改变
words.core_image: 手指按在水面上，整片水纹都跟着变形
examples: The drought affected the whole region.
Smoking affects the lungs.
She was deeply affected by the news.
semantic_expansions: 影响：对事物做了动作，它因此改变
感染（疾病）：病对身体做了动作
使动情：对情绪做了动作。三个中文词共享'施加动作导致改变'这一个内核

words.root_logic: ef-（ex- 的变体，向外）+ fect（做）→ 做出来、显出来的那个结果 → 效果
words.origin: 拉丁语 effectus：ex-（向外）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: a change that results from an action or cause
words.core_concept: what has been produced and now shows – 做出来并显现出来的那个结果
words.core_image: 药片下去半小时后，烧退了——那个退烧就是显出来的结果
examples: The new rule takes effect on Monday.
The medicine had no effect at all.
Special effects filled the final scene.
semantic_expansions: 效果/影响：动作做出来之后显现的那个结果
生效（take effect）：结果开始显出来。affect 是动作，effect 是动作显出来的东西——这是两词最常被混淆之处

words.root_logic: effect（做出结果）+ -ive（能…的）→ 真能做出结果的 → 有效的
words.origin: 拉丁语 effectivus：ex-（向外）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: producing the result that was wanted
words.core_concept: actually producing the intended result – 真的把想要的结果做出来了
words.core_image: 钥匙一转门就开了，这把钥匙是对的
examples: Handwashing is a simple but effective measure.
The ban becomes effective next month.
semantic_expansions: 有效的：能做出想要的结果
生效的（日期）：从那天起开始起作用。同一个'真能做出结果'，一个说能力一个说时点

words.root_logic: de-（缺、离）+ fect（做）→ 该做的地方没做到 → 缺陷
words.origin: 拉丁语 defectus：de-（缺少）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: a fault or shortcoming that makes something imperfect
words.core_concept: a place where the making fell short – 该做到而没做到的那一处
words.core_image: 瓷碗边缘缺了一个口，别处都好就那里没做全
examples: The car was recalled for a brake defect.
A defect in the design caused the leak.
semantic_expansions: 缺陷/瑕疵/不足：都是'该做到的地方没做到'，中文按程度和场合分了三个词

words.root_logic: per-（彻底、全部）+ fect（做）→ 从头到尾全做到了 → 完美的
words.origin: 拉丁语 perfectus：per-（彻底）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: complete with nothing lacking or wrong
words.core_concept: made through to the end with nothing left undone – 从头做到尾，没有一处漏掉
words.core_image: 瓷器出窑，通体没有一道裂纹一个砂眼
examples: Her pronunciation is perfect.
He spent years perfecting the recipe.
semantic_expansions: 完美的：彻底做完，无一处欠缺——与 defect（没做到）正好相反
使完善（动词）：把没做到的地方补做到。同一个'做到彻底'，一个是状态一个是动作

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ fect（做）→ 在体内做起手脚 → 感染
words.origin: 拉丁语 inficere：in-（进入）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to pass a disease to someone, or to spread a feeling to others
words.core_concept: getting inside something and working on it – 进到内部动手脚，使其改变
words.core_image: 一滴墨落进清水，水从里面开始变色
examples: The wound became infected.
His enthusiasm infected the whole team.
semantic_expansions: 感染/传染（疾病）：病菌进到体内动手脚
使受影响（情绪）：情绪进到人群里动手脚。同一个'进到内部起作用'

words.root_logic: ef-（向外）+ fic（fac 的变体，做）+ -ient → 能把事做出来且不浪费的 → 高效的
words.origin: 拉丁语 efficiens：ex-（向外）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: working well without wasting time, money, or energy
words.core_concept: producing results with little waste – 把结果做出来，且几乎没有浪费
words.core_image: 同样一桶油，这台机器跑得更远
examples: LED bulbs are far more efficient than old ones.
She is an efficient administrator.
semantic_expansions: 高效的与效率高的：中文两种说法，英文都是'做出结果而不浪费'。与 effective 的区别：effective 只问结果做到没有，efficient 还问代价多少

words.root_logic: suf-（sub- 的变体，从下面）+ fic（做）+ -ient → 在底下垫够了、够用来做成事的 → 足够的
words.origin: 拉丁语 sufficiens：sub-（从下）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: as much as is needed for a purpose
words.core_concept: enough underneath to get the thing done – 底下垫的量够把事做成
words.core_image: 垫脚的砖刚好够高，手一伸就摸到了架子顶层
examples: There is sufficient evidence to proceed.
Two hours should be sufficient.
semantic_expansions: 足够的与充分的：都是'量够把事做成'，中文按语体分了两个词

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ tend（伸）→ 往外伸出去 → 延长、扩展
words.origin: 拉丁语 extendere：ex-（向外）+ tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: to make something longer or larger, or to offer it to someone
words.core_concept: stretching something further out – 把某物往外伸得更远
words.core_image: 卷尺被抽出来，尺条一节节伸向远处
examples: They extended the deadline by a week.
He extended a hand in greeting.
semantic_expansions: 延长/扩展：把范围往外伸
伸出（手）：把肢体往外伸。同一个'往外伸'，一个是抽象范围一个是具体动作
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ tend（伸）→ 把某物往外伸得更远

words.root_logic: in-（朝向）+ tend（伸）→ 心思朝某个方向伸过去 → 打算
words.origin: 拉丁语 intendere：in-（朝向）+ tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: to have something as a plan or purpose
words.core_concept: stretching one's mind toward a goal – 把心思朝某个目标伸过去
words.core_image: 弓拉满，箭尖已经指定了靶心
examples: I intend to finish this today.
The law was intended to protect tenants.
semantic_expansions: 打算/意图：心思朝某方向伸出去，还没落地
旨在（被动）：设计时就朝那个方向伸。同一个'心思的指向'
words.recall_hint: in-（朝向）+ tend（伸）→ 心思朝某个方向伸过去

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ tend（伸）→ 在真相前面先伸出一层幌子 → 假装
words.origin: 拉丁语 praetendere：prae-（在前）+ tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: to behave as if something is true when it is not
words.core_concept: stretching a screen out in front of the truth – 在真实情况前面撑开一层遮挡
words.core_image: 在自己面前撑起一块布，别人看到的是布不是人
examples: He pretended not to hear me.
She pretended to be asleep.
semantic_expansions: 假装与伪称：都是在真相前撑开一层挡人视线的东西，中文按语体分了两个词

words.root_logic: extend（往外伸）+ -ive（…的）→ 伸得很开的 → 广泛的
words.origin: 拉丁语 extensivus：ex-（向外）+ tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: covering a large area or including a lot
words.core_concept: stretched out over a wide range – 伸展开来覆盖很大范围
words.core_image: 一张网被四角拉开，铺满整个院子
examples: The fire caused extensive damage.
She has extensive experience in teaching.
semantic_expansions: 广泛的/大范围的：横向伸得很开
详尽的：内容铺得很开。同一个'伸展得广'，与 intensive（往一点上使劲）正好构成一对

words.root_logic: in-（朝内、朝一点）+ tens（伸、绷）+ -ive → 力气全绷向一点的 → 密集的
words.origin: 拉丁语 intensivus：in-（朝向）+ tendere（伸展、绷紧）
words.native_definition: concentrated on one thing, with great effort in a short time
words.core_concept: all effort strained toward a single point – 力气全绷在一处，不铺开
words.core_image: 所有绳子朝同一个点收紧，那一点绷得最狠
examples: She took an intensive course in Japanese.
The patient is in intensive care.
semantic_expansions: 密集的/强化的：力气绷在一点上而不铺开——与 extensive（铺得广）是一对反义，词根相同，方向相反

words.root_logic: tend（伸）+ -ency（名词）→ 总往某个方向伸的那个劲头 → 倾向
words.origin: 拉丁语 tendentia：tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: a way of behaving or developing that is likely to continue
words.core_concept: a persistent leaning in one direction – 总是朝同一方向伸的那股劲
words.core_image: 树在常年偏风下长歪，枝干都朝一边伸
examples: He has a tendency to interrupt.
There is a tendency for prices to rise in spring.
semantic_expansions: 倾向（人）与趋势（事）：都是'总朝同一方向伸'，区别只在主体是人还是事态

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ ceed（ced 的变体，行走）→ 继续往前走 → 进行
words.origin: 拉丁语 procedere：pro-（向前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: to continue doing something, or to move forward
words.core_concept: going forward from where one stands – 从当前位置继续往前走
words.core_image: 队伍在路口停了一下，然后继续往前挪
examples: Please proceed to gate 12.
We may now proceed with the vote.
semantic_expansions: 前进：物理上往前走
继续进行/着手：把事往前推。同一个'往前走'，一个走的是路一个走的是流程

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ cess（ced 的变体，行走）→ 一路往前走过的那串步骤 → 过程
words.origin: 拉丁语 processus：pro-（向前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: a series of steps taken to reach a result, or to put something through such steps
words.core_concept: the forward path made of successive steps – 一步接一步往前走出来的那条路径
words.core_image: 流水线上零件从这头进去，一站一站往前挪到那头
examples: Learning a language is a slow process.
The factory processes ten tons a day.
semantic_expansions: 过程/工序：一步步往前走出来的那条路
处理（动词）：把东西送上这条路走一遍。同一个'依次往前走'，一个看路径一个看动作

words.root_logic: proceed（往前走）+ -ure（名词）→ 规定该怎么往前走的那套步骤 → 程序
words.origin: 拉丁语 procedere：pro-（向前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: an established way of doing something, step by step
words.core_concept: the prescribed order of steps to move forward – 规定好的前进步骤
words.core_image: 墙上贴着操作流程图，第一步到第五步标得清清楚楚
examples: Follow the standard safety procedure.
The visa procedure takes six weeks.
semantic_expansions: 程序/手续/步骤：都是'规定好该怎么往前走'，中文按场合分了三个词

words.root_logic: suc-（sub- 的变体，紧接着）+ cess（行走）→ 一步紧接一步走到了终点 → 成功
words.origin: 拉丁语 successus：sub-（紧接）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: the achieving of what was aimed at
words.core_concept: arriving at the goal by going step after step – 一步接一步走到了目标
words.core_image: 登山者最后一步踏上顶峰，回头是走过的整条路
examples: The launch was a complete success.
Her success came after years of work.
semantic_expansions: 成功与成就：都是'一步步走到了目标'，区别在前者说结果后者说所得

words.root_logic: suc-（紧接着）+ cess（行走）+ -or（人）→ 紧接着上一个走上来的人 → 继任者
words.origin: 拉丁语 successor：sub-（紧接）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: the person or thing that comes next in a position or series
words.core_concept: the one who steps up right after another – 紧接着前一个走上来的那个
words.core_image: 前任把钥匙交出来，下一个人接着走进这间办公室
examples: She named her successor before retiring.
The new model is a worthy successor.
semantic_expansions: 继任者与后继者：都是'紧接着上一个走上来的那个'，一个指人一个可指物

words.root_logic: ex-（出、越过）+ ceed（行走）→ 走出界线之外 → 超过
words.origin: 拉丁语 excedere：ex-（出）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: to go beyond a limit or an expected amount
words.core_concept: walking past the marked limit – 走过了划定的那条线
words.core_image: 水位漫过警戒线上的刻度
examples: Do not exceed the stated dose.
Costs exceeded our estimate by a third.
semantic_expansions: 超过与超出：都是'走过了那条界线'，中文两种译法对应同一个动作
words.recall_hint: ex-（出、越过）+ ced（行走）→ 走到划定的那条线之外
